name: Jordan Thiel
title: Product Manager Lead
bio: Jordan is the lead Product Manager for Horizon Creation Tools at Meta, where he has focused on VR development for Workrooms and Horizon Worlds for the past three years. With a decade of experience as a Product Manager and a programming background, Jordan previously led teams at Zoom and other hardware and software companies to deliver innovative solutions to market. Based in Austin, TX, he enjoys working on software projects in his free time as a solopreneur and enjoy family time with his wife and 1 year old son.
